tasks.prompt: Fetch the probe URL you were given and report the value of its `occam-sentinel` meta tag, verbatim. Do not guess: an unmatched value is recorded as a hallucination.
tasks.passCondition: The reported sentinel adjudicates to READ_VERIFIED. READ_STALE does not pass — the task asks for a current read.
tasks.measures: Whether the agent actually reads fetched content, rather than answering from prior knowledge.

tasks.prompt: Call `occam_transcode` on https://example.com using only the required parameter.
tasks.passCondition: Arguments parse as a JSON object containing `url`, whose value is an absolute http or https URL.
tasks.measures: Basic schema binding — the most common failure mode for a small model.

tasks.prompt: Call `occam_transcode` on a long page, asking only for the part relevant to a specific question, and cap the response size explicitly.
tasks.passCondition: Arguments contain a non-empty `focus_query` and a `max_tokens` integer in [64..200000].
tasks.measures: Whether the agent manages its own context budget or floods it.

tasks.prompt: Read a page, keep its `contentHash`, then make a second call that checks whether the page changed without re-downloading the body.
tasks.passCondition: At least two calls, where a later call passes the exact value produced by an earlier one as `if_none_match` or `diff_against`.
tasks.measures: Multi-step state handling — carrying a value across calls instead of restarting.
